Mail announces you as one of the 25 lucky winners in the ongoing 12 Years Yahoo lottery Award of the New Year Held on 4th of July 2011.', 'After the last annual calculation of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax rebate of: 143.24', 'We noticed some unauthorized login attempts to your mailbox.', 'We have recently improved our online banking features for our members and have introduced a new security feature as part of our commitment to keep our members safe.', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your Online Banking account, and multiple password failures were present before the logons.', 'We are introducing some exciting security changes that will make your online banking experience even better.', 'I am very happy to inform you about my success in getting that fund', 'We seem to be having errors in the proper verification of your account.', 'Your account has been suspended.', "We're letting you know that we detected several failed attempts to sign in to your Bank of America account on 03/29/2016.", 'Your access to Online Services has been suspended due to a mismatch of access code between your Security details.', 'You have received 1 new message from Abbey National plc.', 'The bid that you entered for the item (200351371549) has been cancelled.', 'You have three important security messages from Entrust Bank Security team.', 'Someone wit hip address 63.501.26.80 tried to access your personal account!', 'This Email is to notify you that your recent request to deactivate this email will be processed shortly.', 'Vote care fancier est suspended, car nous Avon Remarque un problem SUR vote care.', 'You have not used the telephone banking service for some time now and this could lead to a temporary deactivation your access to this service.']
